dedupe_keys.name: modelling electricity consumption in office buildings an agent based approach

description: This model simulates electricity use in office buildings by joining four elements: organisational energy management policies and rules, energy management technologies, electric appliances and equipment, and the behaviour of staff. Built for a case study, it was used to test how well different electricity management strategies work and to address practical consumption problems in an office. It is the electronic companion to a paper of the same title by Tao Zhang and was published on CoMSES in 2011 for AnyLogic, updated in 2013. Coverage: one case-study office organisation. Access: free model files on CoMSES; running it needs AnyLogic. Licence: AFL-3.0. Caveats: an older model tied to one organisation, and it needs a commercial tool to run. Simulation uses are testing behaviour and technology measures for office electricity demand and demand response in building operation studies. Related records: the load shedding occupant behaviour model and the ASHRAE global occupant behaviour database.
name: Modelling electricity consumption in office buildings: an agent-based approach
outputs: Office electricity consumption under management strategies
